name: AgencyOS — A Agent
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg && install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian trixie stable" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null && apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker-ce-cli docker-compose-plugin && usermod -aG docker vscode
